generated_domain_tool_count: determined only from audited OperationDefinition groups
rules: A published tool contains exactly one risk class; read and write operations are never bundled.
A published tool contains exactly one execution_mode; inline and async_job operations are never bundled.
A published tool contains exactly one canonical required_scopes set, idempotency mode and confirmation mode; mixed groups fail generation.
Every operation is a discriminated oneOf branch with a const operation_id and exact input/output JSON-Schema refs.
Every operation dispatches only through its shared_handler_ref and verified route_trace_fixture_ref; arbitrary URL, method, header and service inputs are forbidden.
Every route permission is an exact key from role-service/app/initial_data/permission_definitions.json or one of public/authenticated_club_member.
The exact backend permission predicate must be read from backend-route-permissions.v1.json; Unclassified, unknown keys or mismatch fail catalog generation.
A critical_write tool always returns ActionPreviewView before mutation and requires the separate confirmation call.

Annotation derivation is exact: readOnlyHint iff risk=read; destructiveHint iff risk=critical_write; idempotentHint iff idempotency is read/key_required; openWorldHint iff external_effect is comvenio_public/third_party.
Publish and public state changes are critical_write, confirmation-required, destructiveHint=true and openWorldHint=true.
All private tools require explicit club_id; public tools accept only the public allowlist identifiers.
Titles, descriptions, schemas, scopes, operation bindings and annotations are identical for OpenAI and Anthropic.

operation_id.description: const value in each generated oneOf branch

input.description: exact generated operation input schema; never free-form

input.oneOf_rule: one branch per operation_id: operation_id const + input $ref generated/operations/<operation_id>.input.schema.json

output.oneOf_rule: one branch per operation_id: operation_id const + result $ref generated/operations/<operation_id>.output.schema.json

dispatch.path_builder_rule: owned by the extracted shared handler and verified with a recording ComvenioClient; never generated from a raw path expression

virtual_tools.title: Comvenio: Eigene Verbindung
virtual_tools.description: Zeigt ausschließlich die eigene Comvenio-Identität, den gewählten Verein und die aktiven Scopes.

virtual_tools.title: Comvenio: Eigene Rechte erklären
virtual_tools.description: Erklärt nur die eigenen effektiven Rechte im explizit gewählten Verein.

virtual_tools.title: Comvenio: Verfügbare Aktionen erklären
virtual_tools.description: Liefert die freigegebenen Eingabe- und Ausgabeschemata der aktuell sichtbaren Comvenio-Aktionen.

virtual_tools.title: Comvenio: Auftragsstatus
virtual_tools.description: Zeigt den Status eines eigenen asynchronen Auftrags im angegebenen Verein.

virtual_tools.title: Comvenio: Auftrag abbrechen
virtual_tools.description: Bricht einen eigenen Auftrag nur vor dessen irreversiblem Upstream-Commit ab.

virtual_tools.title: Comvenio: Datei-Upload starten
virtual_tools.description: Erstellt ein eigenes, vereinsgebundenes Quarantäne-Upload-Handle nach Rechte-, MIME- und Größenprüfung.

virtual_tools.title: Comvenio: Datei-Upload prüfen
virtual_tools.description: Finalisiert einen eigenen Upload erst nach Hash-, MIME-, Magic-Byte- und Malwareprüfung.

virtual_tools.title: Comvenio: Eigene Datei abrufen
virtual_tools.description: Liefert eine kurzlebige Referenz nur nach erneuter Nutzer-, Vereins-, Eigentümer- und Rechteprüfung.

required_assertions: 303 legacy workflow entries are covered by one or more audited OperationDefinition entries
all 572 current ComvenioClient call sites remain traceable as migration inventory
raw call sites are never compiled directly to runtime tools or action bindings
no tool contains more than one risk_class
all schema refs resolve and contain no unknown/additionalProperties escape hatch
all permissions come from the exact backend audit and resolve to the authoritative role-service definition file
semantic route-trace fixtures pass for every operation_id; publish/public-state fixtures are critical and open-world
